title: Streamlit-pycaret Web Application
summary: A Streamlit web app wrapping PyCaret for end-to-end classification and regression AutoML, offering preprocessing, model comparison, and visualization for uploaded tabular data. Its backward-analysis page imports SDV's GaussianCopula, CopulaGAN, CTGAN, and TVAE tabular synthesizers (plus GreaterThan constraints) to generate synthetic samples for scenario exploration around model predictions.
needs: README does not name authors; repo appears to be a fork/derivative of redcican/pycaret-eidodata based on CI badges.
